name: Startups.co.uk

sources.title: Contact us — hello@startups.co.uk for press releases/news; commercial@startups.co.uk for partnerships; su100@startups.co.uk for the free Startups 100 index (UK businesses <5 years old); thought-leadership guest posts accepted, paid guest posts/link insertions explicitly rejected

requirements: Press releases and news queries: hello@startups.co.uk
Startups 100 index: su100@startups.co.uk — free to apply, UK business launched within the past 5 years; applications open periodically ('we'll announce when applications open')
Guest posts: genuine thought-leadership pitches accepted — paid guest posts and link insertions are explicitly refused and ignored
Commercial partnerships: commercial@startups.co.uk or the publisher's partner form
preparation: UK relevance — the site is the UK's small-business resource
For Startups 100: a UK business <5 years old with a compelling story
For editorial: a genuine small-business news angle
workflow: For the Startups 100 list, email su100@startups.co.uk when applications are open (free)
Pitch thought-leadership guest posts through the contact channel — never offer payment
watchFor: Explicit 'no paid guest posts or link insertions' policy — do not pitch link schemes; emails asking won't get a response
Startups 100 applications open on a cycle — check timing
Reviews/comparisons on the site carry affiliate economics (Marketing VF Ltd publisher model)
countsAsLive: The business appears in a Startups.co.uk article or the annual Startups 100 index
